node.statement: The values u_grp(U bold-dot V) and u_grp(U^dagger) occurring in the all-domain formulas from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws are defined on S_grp=S_delta. Replacing u_grp by u_pol there using the equality from the preceding step gives exactly the root formulas for the first component of the explicit unique inverse; C^1 regularity, the exact identities, and every estimate are preserved under equality of the maps.
